posts.text: We have no hesitation in believing we can build businesses of the future. Our ambition is to make India a deep-tech nation and a leader in advanced manufacturing, leveraging artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Reliance is committed to shaping India's AI-driven future.

posts.text: Greetings to the people of Telangana on their Statehood Day. I am confident that the state will continue to grow and prosper, contributing to the development and progress of our great nation.

posts.text: The conversations between us have been going on continuously, including four days ago, three days ago, two days ago, one day ago and today. Where they lead, one never knows, but as I told Iran, 'It's time, one way or another, for you to make a Deal.'

posts.text: Britain's future lies in embracing innovation and technology while maintaining the values that define us as a nation. I remain committed to ensuring our economy delivers for working families across the UK.

posts.text: I'm running for Ohio Governor to deliver real results — more jobs, stronger communities, and a government that works for the people. Ohio is ready for new leadership and I'm ready to deliver.

posts.text: Proud to see Indian Americans making an impact at the highest levels of American government and society. Our diverse perspectives strengthen the fabric of this nation.
posts.caption: Proud to see Indian Americans making an impact at the highest levels of American government and society. Our diverse perspectives strengthen the fabric of this nation.

posts.text: At the FBI, we are restoring accountability and ensuring the Bureau serves the American people — not political interests. Transparency and the rule of law are the foundations of everything we do.
posts.caption: At the FBI, we are restoring accountability and ensuring the Bureau serves the American people — not political interests. Transparency and the rule of law are the foundations of everything we do.

posts.text: The AI revolution is creating unprecedented opportunities. As we shape US AI policy, our focus is on ensuring American leadership in this transformative technology while keeping the innovation ecosystem vibrant and competitive.

posts.text: The World Bank is working to mobilize unprecedented levels of climate finance and development support. We must act with urgency — every day of delay is a day of increased vulnerability for the world's poorest communities.

posts.text: We are delivering a new chapter for Britain — strengthening our partnership with Europe, investing in clean energy, and ensuring every family has the opportunities they deserve. Change is happening.

posts.caption: Australia is deepening defence and strategic cooperation with India in the Indo-Pacific. Our partnership is built on shared democratic values and a commitment to a free and open region.

posts.text: Europe must strengthen its defence capabilities and technological sovereignty. France is leading the charge on AI regulation, clean energy investment, and ensuring our continent remains a global force for stability and progress.
posts.caption: Europe must strengthen its defence capabilities and technological sovereignty. France is leading the charge on AI regulation, clean energy investment, and ensuring our continent remains a global force for stability and progress.

posts.text: The UAE continues to invest in the future — in AI, space, renewable energy, and human development. Our vision is clear: to build a nation that leads by example and inspires the world with innovation and progress.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although that could happen later. The deal is a 180-day lease with a 90-day mutual cancellation notice. The short-term structure came from SpaceX because we might need the compute back.

posts.text: This is going to be a big year for delivering personal superintelligence, accelerating our business, building infrastructure for the future, and shaping how our company will work going forward. We're investing $115-135 billion in AI infrastructure in 2026.

posts.text: Google's generative AI revenue grew nearly 800% year-over-year. AI Overviews are now in 55% of all web searches, reaching over 2 billion monthly users. We're seeing 2026 as the year of the supply crunch — compute demand is outpacing everything.
